reason: My customers buy from people they know, people they met at a fair or who a friend sent their way. I don't believe a cold email from some domain I've never heard of will land me a serious distribution account, and I'm not paying EUR 5,000 over three months to find out with no meetings promised.
objection: Do they actually understand our niche? An agency in Sofia writing to buyers in my sector can't know the products, the margins or who the real decision makers are, and if they get it wrong it reflects on my name.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesaler like mine, ideally someone I know or can call, telling me they got real orders from it, plus a short paid trial of one month without the 3-month lock-in.
